name: Unsupported provision assumptions -> measurement and completeness risk
rationale: A provision is only as good as its assumptions; undocumented assumptions cannot be distinguished from biased ones. The rule directs the auditor to challenge each key assumption against evidence, to recalculate and sensitivity-test the amounts, and to search for obligations never provided for - developing an independent expectation rather than accepting management's number.
source_reference: Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
